svg.title: Array — nominal Ø21 / Ø37 / Ø45 cm
svg.desc: Orthographic front elevations projected from the open FreeCAD model. Smaller and larger outlines scaled by 21/37 and 45/37. Equal non-scaling stroke width throughout. A proportional study, not final manufacturing geometry.
svg.text: FRONT ELEVATIONS · NOMINAL DIAMETERS · SAME LINE WEIGHT
Active CAD envelope: Ø355.6 × H258.7 mm. Ø37 is nominal; Ø21 / Ø45 use ratios 21/37 and 45/37.
Front + plan projections · equal non-scaling line weight · proportional study, not manufacturing drawings · extruda / 06 NOV 2026
